text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo! I came all the way here to see ya!
...Hey, don't give me that "Who are you?" look!
It's me, me! The one and only Gold Ship!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっ！　
来てやったぜー！
……誰？　
って顔すんなよ！
アタシだアタシ！　
ゴールドシップ様だっつーの！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did ya really forget?
Those days when we traveled around Landosol together and crossed swords...
All that blood, sweat, tears, magic, and youthful adventure...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁ、
本当に忘れちまったのか？
共にランドソルを巡り、
剣を交えた……
あの
血と汗と涙と、
魔法と青春の日々を……！？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, not like we actually have any memories like that.
text_block_list.orig_text: ま、そんな記憶ねーんだけどさ。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'll be sticking around for a while!
Even if ya say no, I won't le-e-et you go♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
つーわけで
しばらく厄介になるぜ！
いやだって言ってもー、
逃・
が・
さ・
な・
い・
ぞ♡

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now that ya get it, quit resisting and come with me!
Let's go! First up, chestnut picking!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかったら観念して
アタシに付き合え！
行くぞー！　
まずは
栗拾いだー！
